title: Mean after fixing a coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $i$ be a coordinate. The uniform mean of $f$ with coordinate $i$ fixed to $1$ equals the uniform mean of $f$ plus its Fourier coefficient at the singleton set $\{i\}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
